Name: OmniGeodeArtifacts
Author: JoshuaSVU
Description:
EDIT: This is for the current release of Stardew Valley (1.2). Works with SMAPI but it is not needed.

Magma Geodes now drop every mineral due to omni-geodes only having stone, clay, ore, and artifact spots. Everything seems to be working but as always, backup your files just in case. Thank!

INSTALL:
Download and decompress the .zip.
Extract to your Stardew Valley game folder.
Overwrite when prompted.

UNINSTALL:
I have included a backup within my mod just in case.
Just delete the "backup" in the name of the file and replace the mod file in the Data folder under Content.

Downloads.Description: All artifacts now appear in OmniGeodes
